text: The midpalatal suture progressively ossifies with age and is typically well advanced toward fusion in adults.
Mewing (habitual tongue posture) remodels adult skeletal jaw and maxilla structure.
Micro-implant-assisted rapid palatal expansion (MARPE) produces measurable skeletal maxillary expansion in adults.
harm_note: MARPE is a clinician-placed skeletal appliance. Reported complications include implant failure, asymmetric expansion, pain and gingival trauma; it requires CBCT assessment and orthodontic supervision.
